theme.title: A space for
theme.description: TEDxArada PLAY explores curiosity, creativity, imagination, experimentation, and the joy of human expression.
theme.extendedDescription: In the spirit of ideas worth spreading, TEDx is a program of local, self-organized events that bring people together to share a TED-like experience. At a TEDx event, TED Talks video and live speakers combine to spark deep discussion and connection. This event is open to the public — we look forward to welcoming you into an experience shaped by ideas worth spreading.

speakers.name: Chapi Mwango
speakers.role: Governance & Policy Professional | AU Ecosystem | Regional Integration
speakers.bio: Chapi Mwango is a Policy Professional and storyteller whose work explores the intersection of identity, leadership, and human connection across Africa. Born between Zambian and Ethiopian heritage and raised in Addis Ababa, his journey across cultures and continents has shaped a deeply reflective perspective on belonging, governance, and shared destiny. Through his work within development and public speaking, Chapi is passionate about building bridges between people, ideas, and generations.

speakers.name: Dagmawi Bedilu
speakers.role: Co-Founder & CSO, Efuyegela Consultants | Game Thinking Lead, EnterAfrica
speakers.bio: Dagmawi Bedilu is an Ethiopian game thinker, tech and innovation consultant, community builder, and serial entrepreneur focused on youth empowerment and meaningful community engagement. A former senior software architect, he transitioned into the world of games and engagement, co-founding initiatives such as Chewata Awaqi, EGA, EnterAfrica, Chewatacon (AGW), and 100Shama. He has spoken at international platforms including Gamescom and A Maze Berlin, and is driven by a mission to inspire joy, creativity, and human connection.

speakers.name: Professor Panagiotis (Panos) Hatziandreou
speakers.role: Educator, Psychologist & Head of School, Lebawi International Academy
speakers.bio: Panagiotis (Panos) Hatziandreou is a senior educational leader, psychologist, and professor with over 30 years of experience in education, leadership, psychotherapy, and institutional development. He is currently Head of School and General Manager at Lebawi International Academy in Addis Ababa, where he works with boards, government agencies, and partners to strengthen educational impact. He has also served as a consultant to U.S. universities on study abroad programs and cross-cultural education, and previously taught psychology at Cascadia College and the University of Washington. His work spans education leadership, teaching, and organizational development, guided by a belief in education as a tool for transformation and connection across cultures. He is also a lifelong learner, currently exploring music, particularly Ethio-jazz and blues vocals.
